title: Act 4: Echos of the Past
changeNote:
## 1.6.0 Changes

- Blitz runs now continue to Act 4: The Watcher, a Rest Site, the Blitz Shop, the Corrupted Player Elite when you have saved opponents, and the Architect. Standard runs are unchanged.
- Defeating the Act 3 boss in Blitz grants a Rare card choice and a potion.
- Blitz keeps its own Corrupted Players, separate from other runs. The Blitz lobby can view and reset them.
- In Blitz, Corrupted Players gain more HP at Ascension 3 (Tough Enemies) and Echo Shard at Ascension 4 (Deadly Enemies).
- In Blitz, The Last Wish grants a random relic instead of 99 Gold.
